name: valyria-app
description: Valyria — a branded Code-OSS distribution with the Valyria autonomous agent as a built-in extension. The editor is the `vscode/` submodule; the agent lives in `extension/`. This root hosts the shared `packages/*` (generated protocol types + the pure event reducer) and the Cargo workspace (`crates/*`). See docs/ARCHITECTURE-VSCODE.md.
